name: vscode-hugo-image-importer
description: Drag-and-drop images into Hugo markdown content. Automatically moves the file to assets/images/YYYY/MM/ and inserts the reference into the frontmatter images array or the document body.

hugoImageImporter.imagesDir.description: Path to the Hugo images directory, relative to the workspace root. Supports both assets/ (Hugo Pipes) and static/ directories. Images are placed directly in this path or in a YYYY/MM/ subdirectory when organizeByDate is enabled. Ignored when usePageBundle is true.

hugoImageImporter.organizeByDate.description: When true (default), images are placed in a YYYY/MM/ subdirectory beneath imagesDir. When false, images are placed directly in imagesDir. Ignored when usePageBundle is true.

hugoImageImporter.usePageBundle.description: When true, the image is placed in the same directory as the markdown file (Hugo leaf bundle / page bundle mode) and referenced with a relative path. The imagesDir and organizeByDate settings are ignored.

hugoImageImporter.frontmatterKey.description: The YAML frontmatter key used for the featured/hero image array. Change to 'image', 'cover', 'thumbnail', etc. to match your theme's schema. Only used when dropping into the frontmatter.

hugoImageImporter.copyInsteadOfMove.description: When true (default), the source image is copied to the destination. The original file is preserved in its source location. When false, the image is moved instead.
